webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: Tell your own systems when things happen here, such as a sale or a payment. Each message is signed so your system can check it came from Ziira.
webhooks.noneHint: Add the address of your system and choose the events it should hear about.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.nameHint: What it is for, for example Stock system.
webhooks.urlHint: Must start with https:// and be reachable from the internet.
webhooks.eventsHint: Choose what this address is told about. Only the fields shown under each event are sent.
webhooks.secretNote: A signing secret is made when you add the webhook. It is shown once.
webhooks.secretWarning: Copy this secret now. It is shown only once. If you lose it, make a new secret from the webhook's menu.
webhooks.secretUse: Your system uses it to check the Ziira-Signature header of each message (see the webhooks guide).
webhooks.testQueued: Test queued. Its result shows in the deliveries.
webhooks.deleteAsk: Delete the webhook {{name}}? Nothing more will be sent to it, and its delivery history is removed.
webhooks.docsNote: Messages are sent by the background worker, never while someone is waiting. If your system stays down, deliveries are retried for 24 hours.
webhooks.noDeliveriesHint: Deliveries appear here when a chosen event happens, or when you send a test.
webhooks.contentGone: The content of this delivery is no longer kept, so it cannot be sent again.

keys.readOnlyHint: The key can look things up but never change them.
keys.companyHint: Limit the key to one company.
keys.rateLimitHint: Optional. Leave empty for the standard limit.
keys.rotateHint: A new key is made with the same access and limits. Give it to the other system, then the old key stops.
keys.overlap: Keep the old key working for
keys.overlapNoneWarn: The old key stops working at once, so the other system fails until it has the new key.
